objective: Independent preplanned paired follow-up comparing exact e1p3/e1p4 binaries over the complete 75-team 2025 field, prompted by a small e1p4 lead in the preceding four-arm validation.

design.pairing: Each fresh panel randomly partitions all 75 teams into 25 three-opponent cohorts; one fresh seed and identical cohort assignment are shared by both candidates.
design.primaryMetric: Candidate team score per battle averaged over the complete field.
